# soniayogi

> Yoga with Sonia Lopez, a 500-hour Yoga Alliance registered teacher (RYT 540) based in Chiswick, West London (W4). In-person classes across West London, live online classes worldwide, private sessions, corporate yoga and an annual retreat in Portugal.

## Classes
- Saturday Vinyasa Flow & Mindfulness Meditation: Saturdays 9:00am, 75 mins, Chiswick Town Hall, Heathfield Terrace, London W4 4JN. All levels. £12.50 drop in, paid in person. https://soniayogi.com/classes-bookings#saturday
- Yang & Yin: Sundays 5:00 to 6:30pm, in person or live online. https://soniayogi.com/classes-bookings#yang-yin
- Yogasana (Vinyasa Krama): Tuesdays 6:30 to 8:00pm, in person or live online. https://soniayogi.com/classes-bookings#yogasana
- Morning Meditation: Monday to Friday 7:15am UK, 20 mins, live online. https://soniayogi.com/online-yoga
- Pricing: drop-in donation based; package of 4 classes £45; gift package of 5 classes £55.
- Private sessions: one to one or small groups, at home or a chosen venue in West London. Price on request.
- Corporate yoga: on-site, virtual or hybrid, London.

## Retreat
- Pause, Breathe, Be Present: 8 to 11 October 2027, Terra Raíz, Alcobaça, Portugal, near Nazaré. £770, £200 deposit. https://soniayogi.com/retreat

## Areas served
Chiswick, Turnham Green, Acton, Ealing, Hammersmith, Shepherd's Bush, Brentford, Kew, Richmond, Barnes, Putney, Fulham, Kensington, Notting Hill, and online worldwide.
